text: Again, Eurybiades lifting up his staff as if he were going to strike, Themistocles said, "Strike if you will, but hear;" Eurybiades, wondering much at his moderation, desired him to speak, and Themistocles now brought him to a better understanding.
author: Plutarch
speaker: Themistocles
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
